in_sanskrit.name: पुनित
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who has undergone a penance or has been purified through penance

in_hindi.name: Punit
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Punishment
in_hindi.long_meaning: Punit एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who gives punishment or reward according to one's deeds

in_tamil.name: Punit
in_tamil.long_meaning: Punit ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। One who gives punishment or reward according to one's deeds

in_telugu.name: Punit
in_telugu.long_meaning: Punit ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। One who gives punishment or reward according to one's deeds

in_marathi.name: Punit
in_marathi.long_meaning: Punit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who gives punishment or reward according to one's deeds

in_bengali.name: Punit
in_bengali.long_meaning: Punit একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who gives punishment or reward according to one's deeds
